title: Make OrderService depend on a port, not SMTP

task.text: `OrderService` does `new SmtpClient()`, so it cannot run without the mail library.
Let the policy own an abstraction and let the detail implement it. `Orders.place(customer)` must still return the same receipt and still put the same confirmation on `SmtpClient.WIRE`.

items: Add `interface Notifier` with `void notify(String customer, String message)`.
`OrderService(Notifier)` keeps `String place(String customer)` and never mentions `SmtpClient`.
Adapt `SmtpClient` to `Notifier` (a small adapter class, or a method reference) and wire it in `Orders.place`.

checks.title: OrderService accepts a Notifier it has never seen

hints.text: The business rule ("confirm the order") should not depend on how the mail goes out. Invert it: the rule states what it needs, and the mail library adapts to that.
Declare `Notifier` next to `OrderService`. Pass it through the constructor. Write `SmtpNotifier implements Notifier` that wraps an `SmtpClient`, and build the pair inside `Orders.place`.

lines: public void notify(String c, String m) { smtp.send(c, m); }
